learning_outcomes.text: On the basis of a deep knowledge of kinematics, statics and dynamics of mechanical system, the course provides the practical and theorical knowledge required for a proper functional design of machines and their devices.

syllabus_topics: Cases of friction in prismatic, revolute, thrust, inclined plane, screw-nut pairs
Cases of idler, driving, and driven wheels
Efficiency, machines in series and in parallel, retrograde motion
Lubrication: Newtonian fluids, mass conservation, constitutive laws, viscosity and units of measurement, Reynolds equation in 2D and 3D, introduction to elastohydrodynamics
Hydrodynamic lubrication: applications – fixed and tilting-pad bearings (axial and radial), bushings, Sommerfeld number
Kinematics: Galileo’s theorem, instantaneous center of rotation, trajectories, centroids and polodes, Euler-Savary theorem, conjugate profiles, inflection circle, Rivals’ theorem, applications

Linkage systems: analysis and synthesis of four-bar and six-bar linkages, slider-crank mechanisms, Roberts’ theorem, Oldham coupling, Cardan joint, brief notes on other joints (Birfield, tripod, Rzeppa)
Gears: friction wheels and motivation for toothed gears, involute curve and its properties, pinion and rack, involute spur gears
Balancing of engines with 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, and 12 cylinders
bibliography: R. GARZIERA: Meccanica delle Macchine, MUP.
E. FUNAIOLI, A.MAGGIORE, U.MENEGHETTI: Lezioni di Meccanica Applicata alle Macchine, Voll.1-2, Patron Editore, Bologna.
